title: Theory and interpretability of Quantum Extreme Learning Machines: a Pauli transfer matrix approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.18377v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum reservoir computers (QRCs) have emerged as a promising approach to quantum machine learning, since they utilize the natural dynamics of quantum systems for data processing and are simple to train. Here, we consider $n$-qubit quantum extreme learning machines (QELMs) with initial-state encoding and continuous-time reservoir dynamics. Applying the Pauli transfer matrix (PTM) formalism reveals the encoding-generated features and their linear transformation by quantum channels, and thereby provides a nonlinear vector autoregression model as an interpretable classical representation of a QELM. We show that the nonlinear information processing capacity of a QELM factorizes into the ability of the encoding to represent a given target function and the decodability of the relevant Pauli features after the effective PTM. translated_title: 量子极限学习机的理论与可解释性：泡利传递矩阵方法
translated_abstract: 量子储层计算机（QRCs）已成为量子机器学习中一种颇具前景的方法，因为它们利用量子系统的自然动力学进行数据处理，且训练简单。本文研究了具有初始态编码和连续时间储层动力学的 n 比特量子极限学习机（QELMs）。通过应用泡利传递矩阵（PTM）形式体系，我们揭示了由编码生成的特征及其经量子通道的线性变换，从而提供了一个非线性向量自回归模型，作为 QELM 的可解释经典表示。我们证明，QELM 的非线性信息处理能力可分解为两个因素：编码表示给定目标函数的能力，以及相关泡利特征经过有效 PTM 之后的可解码性。通过比较几何可解码性与统计可解码性，我们揭示了那些在代数意义上隐藏但仍可恢复的特征。
tldr: 本文利用泡利传递矩阵形式为量子极限学习机建立了可解释的经典表示（非线性向量自回归模型），并证明其非线性信息处理能力可分解为编码表示目标函数的能力与泡利特征的可解码性两部分。
en_tdlr: This paper applies the Pauli transfer matrix formalism to give an interpretable classical representation of quantum extreme learning machines as a nonlinear vector autoregression model, and shows that their nonlinear information processing capacity factorizes into the encoding's ability to represent a target function and the decodability of relevant Pauli features.
